deploybot: reserved window: 2024-11-03 01:15->01:45 UTC. job=metric_index_swap_v1. runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/metric-index-swap :white_check_mark:

nick: propose canary shards [0] (~1%). pause after 1 shard. rollback triggers: metadata lock >400ms, write error rate >0.7% for 2m, or temp index size >8GB.

rachael: ops checklist: 1) pin migration-runner@sha256:beef01 2) flag `enable_new_metric_index` OFF until canary unpaused 3) ops-bot preflight.

ops-bot: preflight queued: replica_lag<40ms, disk_headroom>20%, migration_tests ok. will report 30m prior.

deploybot: image pinned and canary configured. will annotate manual unpause message.
